_comment: CHECKED-IN FALLBACK gate spec for gate_engine.py (mirrors ~/.hermes/bot/gates.json as of 2026-09-13). Used only when none of $HERMES_HOME/bot/gates.json, <root>/bot/gates.json or a gates.json next to the engine module parse. Keep in sync with ~/.hermes/bot/gates.json: cp ~/.hermes/bot/gates.json ~/.hermes/scripts/gates.default.json. D-128 tiered gates. code = hard block; docs = advisory. Unknown => code (fail safe). ci_evidence (2026-09-13): the code/risky tier requires a cited live CI result (ngit CI workflow path + conclusion). A documented absence ('no CI evidence available (reason: ...)') is recognised but never a pass, so it cannot satisfy code. The docs/light tier does NOT require ci_evidence.
